mapper.select: SELECT id, name, cover_url, description, is_installed, play_time, last_played, tags, rating, release_date, developer FROM t_game ORDER BY ${condition.sortType} DESC LIMIT #{limit}, #{size}

SELECT id, name, cover_url, description, is_installed, play_time, last_played, tags, rating, release_date, developer FROM t_game WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{condition.keyword}, '%') ORDER BY play_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}, #{size}
